name: Stir-Fry Beef
description: A quick and flavorful beef stir-fry with vegetables and a savory sauce, served over cooked rice.
recipeIngredient: 2 lb boneless beef sirloin, cut into pieces
1 large green pepper, cut into strips

recipeInstructions.text: Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan.
Add beef and stir-fry until cooked through. Set aside.
Add peppers and onion to the pan and stir-fry until tender.
Stir in the mixture of tomato soup, soya sauce, orange juice, and vinegar. Cook until heated through.
Return beef to the pan and heat through, stirring occasionally.
Serve the beef mixture over cooked rice.

_similar.name: Chicken-Pineapple Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry made with chicken breast, pineapple, and vegetables, served over hot rice.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine chopped onion, diced celery, green pepper strips, and pineapple chunks in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together cornstarch, reserved pineapple juice, cinnamon, and soya sauce.
In a skillet over high heat, add margarine and cook chicken strips for 3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the onion mixture to the skillet and continue cooking for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cornstarch mixture to the skillet, stir well, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cook until the sauce is clear and thickened.
Serve the stir-fry over hot rice.

_similar.keywords: chicken stir-fry, pineapple chicken, quick dinner

_similar.name: Beef Broccoli Stir-Fry
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful stir-fry of beef sirloin and broccoli in a savory soy and oyster sauce mixture.
recipeIngredient: ¾ lb sirloin steak, sliced into 1/8 inch thin strips

recipeInstructions.text: Stir soy sauce into cornstarch in a small cup. Add oyster sauce, salt, and pepper. Stir and set aside.
Heat wok to medium-high. Add the first amount of cooking oil. Add broccoli and stir-fry for 4 minutes until tender-crisp. Transfer to a bowl.
Add the second amount of cooking oil to the hot wok. Add beef strips and stir-fry until desired doneness.
Add broccoli back into the wok. Stir the cornstarch mixture and pour into the beef mixture. Cook until boiling and thickened.

_similar.keywords: beef stir-fry, broccoli, soy sauce, oyster sauce

_similar.name: Beef Taco Bake
_similar.description: A hearty, cheesy taco-inspired casserole made with ground beef, tortillas, and a creamy tomato soup sauce, perfect for a family dinner.
recipeIngredient: 6 (8-inch) flour tortillas or 8 (6-inch) corn tortillas, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 can (10¾ oz) Campbell's condensed tomato soup
1 cup Pace thick & chunky salsa or picante sauce

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium skillet over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef until browned, stirring to separate the meat.
Drain excess fat from the skillet.
Add the tomato soup, salsa, milk, tortillas, and half of the cheddar cheese to the cooked beef. Mix well.
Spoon the mixture into a 2-quart shallow baking dish.
Cover the dish and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.
Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese on top before serving.

_similar.keywords: taco bake, ground beef, cheesy casserole, Mexican-American

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Creamy Beef and Potato Bake
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, zucchini, and a creamy cheddar sauce.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup prepared tomato pasta sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F to 375°F.
In a skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter and oil over medium-low heat. Add potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add zucchini, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook until zucchini is tender.
Spoon the vegetable mixture into a 13x9 inch baking dish. Set aside.
In the same skillet, cook onion and Italian seasoning until onion is tender.
Add ground beef to the skillet and cook until it loses its pink color. Stir in tomato sauce and ½ cup milk.
Spoon the meat mixture over the vegetable layer in the baking dish.
Melt remaining butter in the skillet, stir in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in remaining milk. Cook and stir until the sauce thickens.
Stir in cheddar cheese until melted. Pour the sauce over the meat layer.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, potato bake, creamy sauce
